# Bus Network Redesign: Pilot Proposal

Project lead: Maryam Nazari, transport planner
Date: 16 June 2025

## Goal
Cut overcrowding at peak hours so no route goes above the 85% load limit in the Transport Policy.

## Proposal
- Pilot on Route 7 for 8 weeks, starting 4 August 2025.
- Use 6 buses from the current fleet.
- Reduce the peak gap between buses from 10 to 6 minutes.

## Why Route 7
Passengers say Route 7 is the most overcrowded (see the passenger survey), and it has the most complaints this quarter.

## Open question
The ridership report ranks Route 12 as the busiest route. Check the data before deciding anything permanent.

Budget: see the cost estimate.
